name: Tennessee Wesleyan University
academic_ranking: Small private United Methodist-affiliated university with total enrollment around 1,198 students and an approximately 12:1 student-to-faculty ratio.
financial_aid: Reported net price around $16,414 after scholarships and grants. According to aggregated data, roughly 91% of enrolled undergraduates receive grants or scholarships, averaging about $20,642. Softball-specific athletic scholarship figures not publicly confirmed.
facilities_notes: Softball-specific facility name not confirmed on public pages; TWU athletics venues in Athens, TN include Jack Bowling Field at Athens Insurance Stadium (baseball), James L. Robb Gymnasium, and the TWU Athletic Complex. Softball venue details not verified 2026-07.
program_reputation: Established NAIA program competing in the Appalachian Athletic Conference (member since 2001-02). Long-tenured head coach (Toby Brooks) with 20+ seasons leading the program.
notes: Athletics site (twbulldogs.com) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches; coach names, titles, and contacts confirmed via search-result snippets referencing the school employee/staff directory and public listings. Roster size could not be verified from a live roster page (403). Conference and NAIA division confirmed via public sources. Tuition figure is undergraduate 2024-2025 (~$30,814); graduate tuition listed separately (~$17,750).
